m1.notice.0.text:
BEAR ACTIVITY on Moose, Newfound and Sucker.
A black bear is taking food from campsites. Hang everything, every night.
Seen claw marks, scat, a barrel moved? Tell the counter. We would rather move it than lose it.
— Kawishiwi Ranger District

m1.page.chain.0.text: A bear on Moose, Newfound and Sucker. The notice says hang everything.

m1.bark.torn.text: It got our food pack. We hung it, too. Not high enough, I guess. Opened it right down the seam.

m1.rumour.text: There's a bear working the sites out there. Raspberries are in, so it's fat and it's bold.

m1.say.bear.text: Every summer there's one. This one learned what a barrel means. The district would rather move it than shoot it, if somebody shows them where it goes.

m1.ask.site.b.text: Tell them: out on the Isabella.

m1.ask.site.c.text: Tell them: the far end of Little Sag.

m1.say.site.text: I'll call it in. They'll trap it where you found the sign and truck it up there. The district pays for a report like that. It'll be on your tally.

m1.end.relocated.text: Trapped on the chain and moved. A tag in its ear now. The sites are quiet.

m1.end.gaveup.text: Three camps hanging their food, and it quit the chain. Back to the raspberries.

m1.end.trapped.text: September. The rangers trapped it themselves and moved it. Nobody asked me.

m1.end.lost.text: September. Too many camps fed it. They didn't move this one.

m1.page.claw.text: Claw marks on a hung pack. Hung too low.

m1.page.scat.text: Scat full of raspberry seeds. Berries first, then the camps.

m1.page.barrel.text: A barrel dragged into the brush, lid still on. Tooth holes.

m1.page.range.text: It works the chain after dark. Same sites, same hours.

m1.page.seen.text: Saw it come in. Big, careful, in no hurry.

m1.page.photo.text: A picture of it at night. Eyes in the lamp.

m1.page.taught.text: Showed a camp how to hang a pack. They did it while I watched.

m1.page.fed.text: It got food again. Somebody else's camp.

m1.page.fedme.text: It got mine. Not proud of that.

m1.teach.text: Hang your food tonight. There's a bear on this chain.

m1.taught.text: A bear? Okay. Show us the knot.

m1.watch.come.text: Something big in the brush. Lamp off. Wait.

m1.watch.gone.text: It went back the way it came.

m1.pay.text: $40 from the district. The bear report.

m1.first.text: First stamped: a bear's range, written down.

m2.rumour.text: Fella from Crane Lake swears he heard singing on La Croix. In French. In the fog. I said that'd be the Ely High band.

m2.voices.text: Voices in the fog. Singing. Paddles, a lot of them.

m2.voices.near.text: Close now. The paddles knock on the gunwales.

m2.voices.gone.text: Gone east. The fog lifts on nothing.

m2.page.log.loon.text: A logbook in a box at Loon Falls. Yesterday's line: "Four canoes. Bound east."

m2.page.log.curtain.text: Curtain Falls. The box again. "Carried the falls at noon. Singing the whole way."

m2.page.log.basswood.text: Basswood Falls. "Lost a paddle in the white water. Did not stop."

m2.page.log.prairie.text: Prairie Portage, our side. "A pipe here. Then on."

m2.page.log.knife.text: Knife Lake. "Grand Portage in nine days." The ink still wet.

m2.page.heard.text: Fog on La Croix at dawn. Voices. A song I didn't know.

m2.page.close.text: Close enough to hear the paddles knock. Never saw a canoe.

m2.page.filled.text: Five boxes, five lines, always the day before I got there.

m2.keeper.passed.text: Somebody at Grand Portage called. Four big canoes came in off the lake last week, singing. Nobody knew who they were.

m2.end.text: They made Grand Portage. I never caught them.

m2.first.text: First stamped: a logbook, filled east.

m3.hello.0.text: Name's Lund. Arvid. I had the whole route planned. Knees say no. My daughter drove me up anyway.

m3.page.who.0.text: Lund at the dock. Retired from the Virginia plant. His daughter drove him up.

m3.hello.1.text: Harold Sjoberg. I strung wire for the co-op thirty years. Now the doctor says no portages. My son-in-law brought me to look.

m3.page.who.1.text: Sjoberg at the dock. Thirty years a lineman for the co-op. His son-in-law brought him.

m3.hello.2.text: Leonard Maki. I taught shop in Mountain Iron. I can't lift the canoe anymore. My granddaughter's in the car.

m3.page.who.2.text: Maki at the dock. Taught shop at Mountain Iron. His granddaughter waits in the car.

m3.hello.3.text: Gene Kozlowski. Drove truck for the mill in Sartell. My wife sent me with a thermos and told me to sit.

m3.page.who.3.text: Kozlowski at the dock. Drove truck for the paper mill in Sartell. His wife sent him with a thermos.

m3.hello.4.text: Cliff Ness. I carried mail in Two Harbors. Ankle's shot. My nephew drove up from the Cities so I could see the water.

m3.page.who.4.text: Ness at the dock. A mail carrier in Two Harbors. His nephew drove up from the Cities.

m3.hello.5.text: Ray Bergquist. Kept the books at a lumberyard in Cloquet. Heart, they say. My daughter-in-law drove.

m3.page.who.5.text: Bergquist at the dock. Kept the books at a lumberyard in Cloquet. His daughter-in-law drove him.

m3.list.0.text: Ensign, Knife, Kekekabic, Ogishkemuncie and Seagull. A picture from each. I'd like to see them one more time.

m3.page.list.0.text: His list: Ensign, Knife, Kekekabic, Ogishkemuncie and Seagull. A picture from each.

m3.list.1.text: Lake One, Lake Two, Lake Three, Lake Insula and Alice. A picture from each. I'd like to see them one more time.

m3.page.list.1.text: His list: Lake One, Lake Two, Lake Three, Lake Insula and Alice. A picture from each.

m3.list.2.text: Basswood, Crooked, Iron, Lac La Croix and Fourtown. A picture from each. I'd like to see them one more time.

m3.page.list.2.text: His list: Basswood, Crooked, Iron, Lac La Croix and Fourtown. A picture from each.

m3.list.3.text: Sawbill, Alton, Kelso, Polly and Malberg. A picture from each. I'd like to see them one more time.

m3.page.list.3.text: His list: Sawbill, Alton, Kelso, Polly and Malberg. A picture from each.

m3.list.4.text: Brule, Cherokee, Frost, Little Saganaga and Gabimichigami. A picture from each. I'd like to see them one more time.

m3.page.list.4.text: His list: Brule, Cherokee, Frost, Little Saganaga and Gabimichigami. A picture from each.

m3.list.5.text: Snowbank, Disappointment, Ima, Thomas and Fraser. A picture from each. I'd like to see them one more time.

m3.page.list.5.text: His list: Snowbank, Disappointment, Ima, Thomas and Fraser. A picture from each.

m3.ask.text: Would you go for me? Five places. I'll write them down.

m3.wait.text: Any luck? No hurry. The lakes aren't going anywhere.

m3.back.text: That's it. That's the one. You don't know. Thank you.

m3.page.all.text: All five. He'll want to see them.

m3.end.thanks.text: Showed him all five at the dock. He kept looking at the last one.

m3.end.home.text: He went home at freeze-up. I still have the pictures I got.

m3.pay.text: $30 from the man at the dock. For the pictures.

m4.ask.1.text: Since you're out there anyway. Somebody left a mess at a site. Pack it out? I'll put it on the board in your name.

m4.ask.2.text: You again. Good. There's a tree down across a carry. Got a saw?

m4.ask.3.text: Third time. People are going to talk. Another site needs packing out.

m4.ask.4.text: We rotate out end of the month. One last check on a chain before the ice. I trust your eyes.

m4.busy.text: Do that one first. We'll be around.

m4.name.0.text: I'm Tom, by the way. That's Kelsey. Kelsey does the actual work.

m4.page.partner.0.text: The rangers are Tom and Kelsey.

m4.name.1.text: I'm Tom, by the way. That's Marcus. Marcus does the actual work.

m4.page.partner.1.text: The rangers are Tom and Marcus.

m4.name.2.text: I'm Tom, by the way. That's Jen. Jen does the actual work.

m4.page.partner.2.text: The rangers are Tom and Jen.

m4.name.3.text: I'm Tom, by the way. That's Dale. Dale does the actual work.

m4.page.partner.3.text: The rangers are Tom and Dale.

m4.name.4.text: I'm Tom, by the way. That's Priya. Priya does the actual work.

m4.page.partner.4.text: The rangers are Tom and Priya.

m4.name.5.text: I'm Tom, by the way. That's Nils. Nils does the actual work.

m4.page.partner.5.text: The rangers are Tom and Nils.

m4.page.met1.text: Two rangers. Asked where I came in. Asked about my food.

m4.page.met3.text: Tom and his partner again. A third favour.

m4.page.three.text: Three favours done for the district.

m4.page.last.text: One of their last checks before freeze-up.

m4.end.last.text: Did their last check. Tom said "Good camp" and meant the summer.

m4.end.rotated.text: The rangers rotated out for the winter. Somebody else's district till spring.

m4.first.text: First stamped: a favour for the district.

m5.say.bet.0.text: Vern says you can't do Farm, Garden and Clear and be back at this counter before the ice. I say you can. Twenty dollars says one of us is wrong.

m5.page.bet.0.text: Two old guides bet on me: Farm, Garden and Clear and back before the ice.

m5.say.bet.1.text: Vern says you can't do Lake One, Lake Two, Lake Three and Lake Four and be back at this counter before the ice. I say you can. Twenty dollars says one of us is wrong.

m5.page.bet.1.text: Two old guides bet on me: Lake One, Lake Two, Lake Three and Lake Four and back before the ice.

m5.say.bet.2.text: Vern says you can't do Perent, Isabella and Bog and be back at this counter before the ice. I say you can. Twenty dollars says one of us is wrong.

m5.page.bet.2.text: Two old guides bet on me: Perent, Isabella and Bog and back before the ice.

m5.say.bet.3.text: Vern says you can't do Perent and Isabella and be back at this counter before the ice. I say you can. Twenty dollars says one of us is wrong.

m5.page.bet.3.text: Two old guides bet on me: Perent and Isabella and back before the ice.

m5.say.back.text: Well. Vern, pay up. Not you. Him. Twenty dollars and he's still not happy about it.

m5.skim.text: Skim ice. The paddle handle breaks it.

m5.page.skim.text: Skim ice in the bays. Broke it with the paddle handle. Sounds like glass.

m5.page.out.text: Out on the run. Snow on the birch.

m5.page.round.text: Every lake on their route. Now back before it closes.

m5.end.made.text: Made it back. Ernie won. Vern says it doesn't count.

m5.end.ice.text: The ice won. It usually does.

m5.first.text: First stamped: the last trip of the year.

m6.say.text: Thirty days in, one resupply? People do it. Pick what it's for or you'll just get tired. Lakes, fish, pictures, nights.

m6.page.lakes.text: The long stay: fifty lakes in thirty days.

m6.say.species.text: Every species. You'll want a better rod.

m6.page.species.text: The long stay: every fish in the water, in thirty days.

m6.say.photos.text: Thirty pictures. Make them good ones.

m6.page.photos.text: The long stay: thirty pictures in thirty days.

m6.say.nights.text: Thirty nights. That's the whole thing, really.

m6.page.nights.text: The long stay: thirty nights out.

m6.page.resupply.text: Came out once for food. That's the one.

m6.page.second.text: Came out a second time. Doesn't matter. It's mine.

m6.end.done.text: Thirty days and what I said I'd do.

m6.end.yours.text: Thirty days. Not all of it. It's still mine.
